propositions: The completion-verifier standing eval constructs a single PydanticAIRunner before disposable fixture repositories are created, causing its LLMConfig.repo_path to reference the eval checkout rather than per-case fixture roots.

The _effective_config method substitutes only request-level model/limit tuning and preserves the runner's base repo_path, so filesystem and ticket tools read the checkout instead of each case's disposable repository.
Targeted COMPLETE cases failed (epoch_pass [False, False, False]) because agentic tools could not find fixture files such as src/cli.py or app/profile.py in the checkout.
The fix re-roots the injected PydanticAIRunner at each disposable case store via _rerooted and clears tickets_path so ticket tools read the fixture's seeded store, restoring correct test behavior.
After the fix, all 11 completion-verifier cases pass in 3 epochs with coverage 1.0 and epoch_pass [True, True, True], confirming agent filesystem tools are now rooted at case fixtures.
